# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.66

- **Linux binaries are now built on Ubuntu 26.04** (x86-64 and ARM64), like the rest of the CI. **They need the glibc of Ubuntu 26.04 or newer**: on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 or Debian 12/13 the prebuilt Linux files may not start; build from source there (`cargo build --release`). Windows and macOS builds are unchanged.
- The release workflow prints the glibc version each Linux binary needs instead of enforcing the old floor (2.35).
